title: Projection compatibility for the composite stage tail
statement: For the same maps, squares, pullback-map equation, opens and local objects as the parent component theorem, let D be the constructed composite stage tail on each Boolean branch. Then D followed by the fixed projection comparison chi equals the derived transport followed by pullback of the fixed f-stage object comparison sigma. The site counit, natural comparison eta and constructed full stage map do not occur in the conclusion.

source.place: Restriction compatibility; fixed derived-pullback composition in Tag 0D5S.

proof.text: Fix the maps and the pullback-map equation once. Prove the component identity locally for an arbitrary open L containing U intersection V, an object M on L, and the induced inclusion of the f-inverse-image intersection. The two Boolean branches then specialize this calculation to U,A and V,B.

Use perfectOverlapNestedRestrictedMaps and perfectOverlapRestrictedComposite to obtain the commuting nested square and its composite r followed by p equals t. Obtain both cartesian first-projection equations from perfectOverlapStageSchemeIso_inv_projection and its equality with the raw cartesian isomorphism.

Expand the inverse nested pullback square. Naturality of the inverse open-inclusion comparison moves local composition across it and cancels the adjacent isomorphism components. Apply compositionTo_prism, identify its reflexive named composites with perfectHomComposition, and identify the local composite using perfectOverlapCompositeLocalIso_eq_compositionTo. Use the existing perfectOverlapStageObjectIso_hom_app equations to factor the two stage-object components; the definition itself stays hidden.

Map the inside calculation by the cartesian derived pullback and apply perfectOverlapProjectionCompositeAbstract to the projection factors. Naturality of the fixed derived transport moves the K-inclusion comparison and K-composition to the other side. Functor.map_comp and associativity give the K-stage-object component. Unfold the direct stage-transport construction and the composite tail, then specialize to both Boolean branches.

theorem perfectOverlapTailProjectionComponent
    {X Y K C T S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : K ⟶ Y) (gk : X ⟶ K) (g : X ⟶ Y) (hgf : gk ≫ f = g)
    (pX : X ⟶ C) (pK : K ⟶ T) (pY : Y ⟶ S)
    (b : C ⟶ S) (q : T ⟶ S)
    (hg : IsPullback g pX pY b) (hf : IsPullback f pK pY q)
    (l : Over.mk b ⟶ Over.mk q)
    (U V : Y.Opens)
    (A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (B : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (φU : (derivedPullback (g ∣_ U)).obj A ≅
      (schemeOpenRestriction X (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)
    (φV : (derivedPullback (g ∣_ V)).obj B ≅
      (schemeOpenRestriction X (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) :
  let W := U ⊓ V
  let s := W.ι ≫ pY
  let r := gk.resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) (g ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hgf])
  let m := baseChangeMap s l
  let eY := ((isPullback_morphismRestrict g W).paste_vert hg).isoPullback
  let eK := ((isPullback_morphismRestrict f W).paste_vert hf).isoPullback
  ∀ hmap : eY.inv ≫ r = m ≫ eK.inv,
  let data := transportDataOfComposite f gk g hgf U V A B E φU φV
  let F : Bool → schemeDerivedCategory (f ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme := fun a ↦
    if a then
      (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction K
        (homOfLE (inf_le_right : f ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).obj B)
    else
      (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction K
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : f ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ U)).obj A)
  let apex := perfectOverlapApexEquivalence g pX pY b hg U V
  let η := perfectOverlapNaturalComparisonOfSquare g f pX pK pY b q hg hf U V r m hmap
  let σ : ∀ a : Bool,
      (perfectOverlapStageEquivalence f pK pY q hf U V).functor.obj (F a) ≅
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s q)).obj
          (if a then (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ V))).obj B
          else (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ U))).obj A) := fun a ↦
    Bool.casesOn a
      ((perfectOverlapStageObjectIso f pK pY q hf U V U inf_le_left).app A)
      ((perfectOverlapStageObjectIso f pK pY q hf U V V inf_le_right).app B)
  let D : ∀ a : Bool,
      (perfectOverlapStageEquivalence g pX pY b hg U V).functor.obj
          ((derivedPullback r).obj (F a)) ⟶
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s b)).obj
          (if a then (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ V))).obj B
          else (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ U))).obj A) := fun a ↦
    Bool.casesOn a
      (perfectOverlapCompositeStageTailAt f gk g hgf pX pY b hg U V U inf_le_left A)
      (perfectOverlapCompositeStageTailAt f gk g hgf pX pY b hg U V V inf_le_right B)
  ∀ a : Bool,
    D a ≫ (perfectHomComparison s l).hom.app
        (if a then (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ V))).obj B
        else (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ U))).obj A) =
      (perfectOverlapStageTransport g f pX pK pY b q hg hf U V r m hmap).hom.app (F a) ≫
        (derivedPullback m).map (σ a).hom
